wu: Mime the animal: Teacher mimes an animal (e.g., flapping arms like a duck), kids guess 'What is it?' and say the name and sound, e.g., 'It is a duck! Quack quack!'
wuAlt: Animal sound bingo: Teacher calls out animal sounds, kids cover the matching picture on their bingo cards
Flashcard jump: Lay flashcards on the floor, kids jump to the correct card when teacher says 'Jump to the cow!'
pres: Show flashcards of cow, horse, sheep, duck, chicken, pig; ask 'What is it?' and model 'It is a cow'; then ask 'What can a cow do?' and model 'A cow can eat grass'; ask 'Can a cow fly?' and model 'A cow can't fly'
presAlt: Farm animal story: Read a simple story like 'Dear Zoo' with farm animals, pause to ask 'What can it do?'
TPR actions: Teacher does actions (eat, run, fly) and asks 'Can a cow fly?' kids respond 'No, it can't'
prac: Cut-and-stick poster: Kids cut out animal pictures and labels, stick them on a farm poster, then say 'It is a sheep' and 'A sheep can eat grass'
pracAlt: Animal can/can't pelmanism: Match picture cards with sentence cards like 'A duck can swim'
Find the animal: Kids search for hidden animal cards, when found say 'It is a pig' and 'A pig can roll in mud'
ls: Listen and draw: Teacher says sentences like 'Draw a cow. A cow can eat grass. A cow can't swim', kids draw and check
re: Santa Says: Teacher says 'Santa says hop like a horse' or 'Santa says quack like a duck', kids do the action only if 'Santa says' is included
prod: Farm animal survey: Kids walk around and ask three friends 'Can a horse fly?' and 'Can a horse run?', tally answers and report back
rw: Read and match: Kids read simple sentences like 'A duck can swim' and match them to the correct animal picture, then write 'A duck can swim' on their paper
st: Sing 'Old MacDonald' with actions for each animal, then do goodbye routine: Goodbye Song + sticker chart + high-five line
g: One child mimes an animal, others guess 'What is it?' and say what it can do
Teams race to complete sentences like 'A pig can ___' on the board
Kids draw an animal and others guess what it can do
Teacher says an animal sound and action, kids do both
Kids match baby animals to mothers and say what they can do
diff: Fast finishers: Write 5 sentences about what farm animals can and can't do
Support learners: Trace the sentences 'A cow can eat grass' and match to pictures
hw: Write 3 sentences about farm animals and draw a picture
Teach 'Old MacDonald' to someone at home with actions
Make a list of 3 animals you can see in Morocco and what they can do
tip: Use TPR (total physical response) to reinforce can/can't by doing actions for 'can' (thumbs up) and 'can't' (crossed arms), making abstract grammar concrete for young learners.
